contentText: Russia has launched another deadly barrage of strikes on Kyiv. According to Ukrainian authorities, at least fourteen people have been killed, just hours after President Volodomyr Zelensky warned another attack was imminent. Earlier on July 5 the city of Zaporizhzhia was also hit and Moscow claims it has captured the town of Kostyantynivka in the east of the country. Kyiv has dismissed the announcement.
